answer: Brilliant Lode: closure year 1917 is the latest End Year in the MINOCC 2017 MineHist table for this site (MINOCC-2017:MineHist:38722:1): the last recorded period of working ended then, which says when working last ended, not why; other sources give 1917 (WP-CTSHAFTS), not used here. Gold in 1917 averaged US$20.67/oz nominal (mean of the official US gold price over the months of the year held (a statutory price, not a market average); 12 months; no A$ figure is held for that year). In 2026-10 US dollars that is US$543.97/oz (US CPI-U, 1917 average 12.825 against 337.511). Gold in 2026-10 averaged US$4105/oz, 7.55 times the closure-year price in today's dollars. US-dollar purchasing power (US CPI-U); not an Australian-dollar figure. CPI snapshot taken 2026-11-21.
